method: Direct image inspection of all eight retained browser screenshots
observations: Approval, pending apply, uncertain outcome and applied/reconciled states are visually distinct and include text labels
Keyboard focus is visible on the approval conclusion and confirmation checkbox
French and English retained-result text and long hashes wrap within the mobile panel

limitations: Visual inspection of these captured states only. Six automated axe scans are recorded separately. No screen-reader or whole-application accessibility certification.
